test_title: PYST 38: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Anmol and Ayushi together invested ₹41,400 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹5,000, Anmol's share was ₹2,300. How much was Anmol's investment?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit ratio = Investment ratio

Anmol's share = 2300 out of 5000 ⇒ ratio = 23 : 50

Total investment = 41400

Anmol's investment = (23/50) × 41400

**∴ Answer = 19044**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = 41400

Total profit = 5000, Anmol's share = 2300

**Formula used:**

Profit ratio = Investment ratio

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of profit = 2300 : (5000 − 2300) = 2300 : 2700 = 23 : 27

⇒ Ratio of investment = 23 : 27

⇒ Total parts = 50

⇒ Anmol's investment = (23/50) × 41400

⇒ = 19044

**∴ The correct answer is ₹19044.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Rule

Profit ∝ Investment (if time is same)

Ratio Simplification

Always reduce ratios to simplest form

Share Formula

Individual share = (ratio part / total parts) × total amount
